classification.difficultyReason: The statement order ZXY is scrambled and the second given angle is on the image. The student must map it back to C, find B by angle sum, then transfer it to X.

content.prompt: These two triangles are similar: $ABC\sim ZXY$.

answer.worked:
$Y$ corresponds to $C$, so $\angle ACB=\angle ZYX=39^\circ$.
$$\begin{align*}\angle ABC&=180^\circ-54^\circ-39^\circ\\&=87^\circ\\\angle ZXY&=\angle ABC=87^\circ\end{align*}$$ since $X$ corresponds to $B$.
